text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The air trade war between British Airways and Air Zimbabwe is heading towards a profitable peace after the two countries agreed last week to increase capacity on their flights to a maximum of 1,600 passenger seats and 180 tonnes of cargo a week in each direction.
- Ten master plans for Zimbabwe's domestic airports have been completed as the first stage of a government programme to upgrade the existing infrastructure.
